sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 31 points, travel to Dawley Town on Saturday 31 October at 14:00. Despite their recent loss, the league leaders remain strong having won four consecutive league matches before that setback, and will be looking to bounce back against mid-table Dawley Town.
divisionWide: The title race features a tight battle at the summit. Second-placed AFC Bridgnorth and third-placed Bilston Town (26 points) are within striking distance of leaders Sandbach. Bilston have been particularly impressive with five consecutive league wins, while Stafford Town (fourth, 26 points) have shown consistency with their recent draw-draw-win-draw-draw-win sequence. Stafford host title-chasing Telford Town on Saturday at 15:00 in what should be a compelling encounter given Telford's struggles at the bottom of the table. In-form Wolverhampton Casuals, sitting fifth with 25 points and on a strong run of four wins in their last five, welcome basement club Allscott Heath (though Allscott have won four of their last five). Eccleshall, unbeaten in their last three league matches, face Shawbury United away on Saturday at 15:00 in a meeting of mid-table sides. Foley Meir host Barnton on Saturday at 15:00—both teams are in mid-table with reasonable recent form. New Mills entertain Wednesfield Community on Saturday at 15:00 in a clash between struggling sides. Cheadle Heath Nomads, despite sitting tenth with recent draws and wins mixed in, host Brereton Social on Saturday at 15:00. Market Drayton Town, winless in five league matches, host in-form Crewe on Saturday at 15:00. Widnes Town, bottom of the league, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday at 15:00 in a battle between two of the division's weakest performers. Finally, Telford Town visit Eccleshall on Tuesday 27 October at 19:45 in a midweek fixture—Telford's struggles continue at the bottom while Eccleshall have momentum on their side.
